findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts:447,454-458,460,462,469,485,1000-1001 — session_brief next-step and anti-stall output still emits bare command names (for example reviewer_list, review_run_start, review_pass_set, story_advance) instead of lattice-prefixed examples.
